headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: 2,480 kg sweets destroyed: TGSAFE suspends licences of Bhagya Laxmi Sweets, Balaji Magic.
Telangana ACB nabs 2 Rajanna Sircilla officials over Rs 8000 bribe.
Andhra Pradesh ready for local body polls, awaiting SC verdict on BC quota: Narayana.
Iran’s Oil Minister resigns, no reason given.
Pinarayi Vijayan has sought strigent action against YC workers.
bullets_ur: 2,480 kg mithai talaf: TGSAFE ne Bhagya Laxmi Sweets aur Balaji Magic ke licenses muattal kar diye.
Telangana ACB ne 8000 rupay rishwat par Rajanna Sircilla ke 2 afsaraan ko giraftar kar liya.
Andhra Pradesh baldiati intikhabat ke liye tayyar, BC quota par SC ke faislay ka intizar: Narayana.
Iran ke Oil Minister mustafi, isteefay ki koi wajah samnay nahi aayi.
Pinarayi Vijayan ne YC karkunan ke khilaf sakht karrawai ka mutaliba kiya hai.
